description: This file implements the AssemblyAI real-time speech-to-text WebSocket service, including connection handling, message processing, and integration with the Pipecat framework for speech transcription.

classes.name: AssemblyAISTTService
classes.description: A service class for interfacing with AssemblyAI's WebSocket API for real-time speech-to-text conversion, including connection management, message handling, and frame processing.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, language: Language = Language.EN, api_endpoint_base_url: str = "wss://streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws", connection_params: AssemblyAIConnectionParams = AssemblyAIConnectionParams(), vad_force_turn_endpoint: bool = True, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the AssemblyAISTTService with configuration parameters, including API key, language, endpoint URL, and connection parameters.

methods.name: bool can_generate_metrics(self)
methods.description: Indicates whether the service supports metrics generation; returns True.

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Starts the speech-to-text process, establishing connection and preparing for audio streaming.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops the service and disconnects from the WebSocket, finalizing transcription.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Cancels ongoing transcription, disconnects, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_stt(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Processes raw audio bytes, sending chunks over the WebSocket for transcription, and yields None (async generator).

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Handles incoming frames related to VAD and metrics, initiating connection actions based on frame type.

methods.name: _trace_transcription(self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Language)
methods.description: Records transcription details for tracing purposes.

methods.name: str _build_ws_url(self)
methods.description: Constructs the WebSocket URL with query parameters based on connection settings.

methods.name: _connect(self)
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and starts message reception.

methods.name: _disconnect(self)
methods.description: Gracefully disconnects from WebSocket, sending termination messages and cleaning up.

methods.name: _connect_websocket(self)
methods.description: Handles the actual WebSocket connection establishment.

methods.name: _get_websocket(self)
methods.description: Returns the current WebSocket object, raises exception if not connected.

methods.name: _receive_messages(self)
methods.description: Continuously receives and processes messages from the WebSocket.

methods.name: BaseMessage _parse_message(self, message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Parses raw JSON messages into specific AssemblyAI message models.

methods.name: _handle_message(self, message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Routes WebSocket messages to appropriate handlers based on message type.

methods.name: _handle_termination(self, message: TerminationMessage)
methods.description: Handles termination messages, finalizing the session.

methods.name: _handle_transcription(self, message: TurnMessage)
methods.description: Handles transcription speech results, creating frames for interim and final transcriptions.

ctags.signature: ( self, *, api_key: str, language: Language = Language.EN, api_endpoint_base_url: str = "wss://streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws", connection_params: AssemblyAIConnectionParams = AssemblyAIConnectionParams(), vad_force_turn_endpoint: bool = True, **kwargs, )
